differential.name: Iron deficiency anemia
differential.rationale: Microcytic anemia with low MCV likely from chronic blood loss (e.g., GI bleed, menstrual loss, or trauma related to intimate partner abuse) in a middle‑aged adult.

differential.name: Anemia of chronic disease
differential.rationale: Co‑existing chronic inflammatory conditions (osteoarthritis, chronic sinusitis, obesity, prediabetes) can suppress iron utilization and produce a mild microcytic picture.

differential.name: Beta‑thalassemia trait
differential.rationale: Stable microcytosis with normal hemoglobin and red cell count in a white adult; often discovered incidentally.

differential.name: Sideroblastic anemia
differential.rationale: Acquired forms can be drug‑induced (misuse of substances) and present with microcytosis and elevated platelet distribution width.

differential.name: Lead poisoning
differential.rationale: Occupational or environmental exposure can cause microcytic anemia; lower probability given lack of exposure history.
